meta.qaoa: warm start (clique LP, eps 0.25), CVaR alpha 0.2, p=1, grid 8x8 + COBYLA 60, exact statevector
meta.random_proposer: uniform over all feasible schedules of the subproblem

costs.qaoa: budget = shots of one p=1 circuit per neighbourhood (angles tuned offline on a statevector)
costs.sa: budget = restarts per neighbourhood, each 100 sweeps of n single-spin updates
costs.random: budget = draws per neighbourhood, after enumerating all 2^n assignments to list the feasible ones
costs.random_all: budget = uniform bitstring draws per neighbourhood, no enumeration
costs.exact: brute force over 2^n assignments per neighbourhood; budget ignored (ceiling)
